Sandbox_ACS_ColdTemperature_tooltip: Outdoor air temperature below which food left outside spoils at the fridge rate (uses the vanilla Refrigeration Effectiveness setting). Default: 4.
Sandbox_ACS_FreezeTemperature_tooltip: Outdoor air temperature below which food left outside freezes. Frozen food does not spoil. Default: 0.
Sandbox_ACS_HoursToFreeze_tooltip: In-game hours for food to go from thawed to fully frozen outside. Vanilla freezers take 4. Default: 4.
Sandbox_ACS_FreezersStopSpoilage_tooltip: Food in a powered freezer stops ageing entirely, even before it has fully frozen. Default: on.
Sandbox_ACS_FridgesStopSpoilage_tooltip: Same as above for powered fridges. When off, fridges use the vanilla Refrigeration Effectiveness rate. Default: off.
Sandbox_ACS_ScanRadius_tooltip: Outdoor food and fridges/freezers within this many tiles of the player are updated every 10 in-game minutes. Food further away is corrected as soon as you come back or its area loads. Default: 30.
